Register an immutable product version

Source: R/publish-products.R
soil_product_version.Rd

A version freezes the scientific content of a product: the SHA-256 checksum of the algorithm (code, model artifact), its configuration and the variables it publishes with their target levels. Every variable must be registered (soil_register_variable()) and allow the declared levels. Any scientific change is a new version.

Usage

soil_product_version(
  soil = soil_session(),
  product_code,
  version_code,
  algorithm_checksum,
  variables,
  configuration = list()
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

product_code

Code of the product: lowercase letters, digits, _. API field product_code of POST /products; for soil_product_version(), API path parameter {product_code} of POST /products/{product_code}/versions.

version_code

Code of the version (e.g. "v1.0.0"). API field version_code.

algorithm_checksum

SHA-256 of the algorithm: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters (e.g. openssl::sha256(file("model.R"))). API field algorithm_checksum.

variables

The variables published by the version: a data frame with variable_code and target_levels (a character column, one level per row, or a list column of character vectors), or a list of list(variable_code =, target_levels =). API field variables.

configuration

The configuration of the model, a named list (a JSON object). API field configuration.

Value

The version: a list product_code, product_name, description, product_version_id (the id to open runs), version_code, algorithm_checksum, configuration (list), declared_variables (data frame variable_code, target_levels), created_at.

Details

Registering the same version again returns it (with its product_version_id). A version_code already registered with another checksum, configuration or variables is a soilhub_conflict_error (HTTP 409): register a new version code. An unknown product is a soilhub_not_found_error.

Rights: soil:admin.

See also

Other writing: soil_product(), soil_publish_health(), soil_publish_source(), soil_publish_values(), soil_register_variable(), soil_run_open(), soil_source_validate()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
v <- soil_product_version(
  soil, "soil_health_fuzzy", "v1.0.0",
  algorithm_checksum = as.character(openssl::sha256(file("model.R"))),
  variables = data.frame(variable_code = "soil_health_physical_score",
                         target_levels = "horizon"),
  configuration = list(rule_base = "physical-v1")
)
v$product_version_id
} # }
